execution_contract.scope: minimum research-only handling for explicitly present QD-010 share distributions and rights events
execution_contract.knowledge_time: known_at is conservatively the next local calendar day after the date-only announcement and is usable at that date's 15:00 completed-close decision
execution_contract.effective_boundary: effective_date is the raw-price/share-coordinate boundary and may never be used before known_at
risk_events: distribution with source_terms_complete=true and declared share_multiplier>1
execution_contract.existing_position_rule: on the first market-session close D with known_at<=D 15:00 and D<effective_date, create a risk-reducing exit; fill at the first later legal open strictly before effective_date
execution_contract.new_risk_rule: block entry when the event is known by the signal decision and the proposed entry date is on or before effective_date
execution_contract.fill: raw next-open price less unchanged 20 bps sell cost; keep pending through suspensions and pinned lower limits only while fill_date<effective_date
execution_contract.suspension_valuation: when registered trade_status=0, current_day_data_tradable=false, the only invalid reason is invalid_daily_bar, prices are finite/positive, and no action blocker exists: allow no fill or new risk, apply any exact cash-only action, and carry the registered close for NAV until trading resumes
execution_contract.t_plus_one: same-session exit is forbidden; a same-day entry cannot be sold until a later market session
execution_contract.cash_only_actions: unchanged exact visible-action ledger using cash_per_share and share_multiplier=1
execution_contract.share_transform: no share transformation is performed for a risk event because the position must exit before effective_date
fail_closed: known_at date is not strictly before effective_date
no legal sell fill strictly before effective_date
position reaches an unresolved effective-date row
execution_contract.revision_boundary: QD-010 is bounded PIT-B current-history evidence; no strict PIT-A or historical-absence claim

industry_diffusion_20.signal: unchanged leave-one-out fraction of eligible PIT-industry constituents with positive r20
industry_diffusion_20.selection: unchanged top 10 each weekly signal date

low_idiosyncratic_volatility_20.signal: unchanged negative 20-session standard deviation of stock return minus daily market median
low_idiosyncratic_volatility_20.selection: unchanged top 10 each weekly signal date

classification.PARKED: complete replay with at least one positive return, Sharpe, or drawdown-quality dimension but failure of the mixed gate
classification.REJECTED: complete replay with nonpositive total return and Sharpe and maximum drawdown worse than -50%
classification.REPLAY_BLOCKED: execution contract fails closed before full liquidation

prohibited: no alpha, horizon, universe, clock, threshold, ranking, sizing, breadth, weight, or cost change
no habitat, regime, Formation Depth, calendar-year, or neighboring-parameter conditioning
no effective-date result used before known_at
no inferred corporate-action terms from price
no dropping blocked holdings or quoting partial equity as economics
no strict PIT-A, OOS, validation, live, or production claim
